confirm.apply: Applying the saved configuration restarts this side’s components and may interrupt playback. Continue?
confirm.recover: Keep the unreadable original file and save backup revision {revision} as a new revision? You’ll still need to apply it.
confirm.restore: Restore the previous configuration as a new revision? You’ll still need to apply it.

error.pemSize: Choose a PEM file of at most 128 KiB.

field.endPort: End port (empty for a single port)
field.frontendListen: Public TLS entry IP (empty to disable; shares the inbound port, split by SNI)
field.frontendPort: Public TLS entry port (must equal inbound.listen_port)

home.frpNote: Registers home services over the encrypted link above; the home ID keeps service names apart.
home.listNote: Enter each home service’s real address and port. The Relay mapped port must be in Relay’s allowed range; the app connects by service name and mapped port.
home.singboxNote: The home side reaches Relay over the encrypted connection; the local forwarding entry is only for service registration.

notice.applied: This side’s components applied the revision. Still verify the other side and your media services.
notice.exported: Exported the configuration and secret references—no actual UUIDs, tokens or private keys.
notice.signedIn: Signed in. Saving only updates this side’s JSON; applying switches the running configuration.
notice.tlsImported: Imported TLS file {file}. Select it in the matching field, then save and apply. Re-enter any unsaved secrets.
notice.validated: Draft revision {revision} passed field validation. It isn’t saved or applied yet; use the component check to test it.

overview.credentialSet: Configured; leave empty when editing to keep it
overview.homeFlow: Home services → Connector → encrypted connection → Relay
overview.homeManagement: Open it from your home network by this machine’s IP; admin sign-in is still required. After changing the management entry, restart the manager on the machine.
overview.homeServices: The app reaches these home services through Relay’s mapped ports.
overview.relayFlow: Connector and app → Relay encrypted entry → service registration and forwarding
overview.relayManagement: Public access requires HTTPS and admin sign-in. The manager can share port 443 with the encrypted connection. After changing the management entry, restart the manager on the machine.
overview.relayServices: This side manages service port ranges and access. The actual home services are configured on the Connector.

page.checksHint: Checks run against unsaved changes and don’t prove the remote side is reachable. A restore still needs applying; reloading discards unsaved changes.
page.footer: OpenPlayX · The admin password is separate from your media service accounts
page.identitiesHint: Connectors and apps each use their own identity. Leave a UUID empty to keep it; removing an identity revokes its access.
page.importHint: After importing, select the file in the matching field, then save and apply. Private keys are never returned by read or export APIs.
page.loginHint: For the first sign-in, use the bootstrap-token from this machine’s private config folder. It’s valid for 15 minutes.
page.recover: Keep the original and restore the backup
page.recoveryHint: The original file was kept. After restoring a backup you still need to apply it.
page.rulesHint: Choose which identities may reach which ports; everything else is refused. Ports must be the control port or an allowed mapped port. Separate values with commas; write ranges as start:end.
page.saveHint: Save first, then apply. Applying restarts this side’s connection and may briefly interrupt playback.
page.setPasswordHint: Choose a dedicated admin password of at least 16 characters. Setting it signs out every session.
page.subtitle: Transport and available services

relay.allowNote: Port ranges Connectors may register; leave the end port empty for a single port.
relay.frpNote: Accepts service registration from Connectors, listens on loopback only and requires the encrypted connection.
relay.singboxNote: Connectors and apps reach Relay through this encrypted entry.

secret.keep: Leave empty to keep the current credential
secret.keepUUID: Leave empty to keep the current UUID
secret.newUUID: A new identity needs a UUID

status.restartManager: Manager restart pending on this machine
